title: Measure whether the merge tool's one-fix-check-line limits drop real fix checks from a record (#3505 sighting)
why: Relayed by the coordinator at 10:23 and 10:24 CST Nov 15 from runner 10's words, none read by triage. Runner 10 states two limits of the merge tool: (1) it takes ONE fix-check line per record; (2) it refuses a PASS fix check after an earlier log whose fix check is FAIL. So the #3505 lane's first fix check (haiku, FAIL on length only, read 16321a9e) is not in the record chain. Concern: these limits may drop real fix checks from a record. Size of the loss unmeasured; one sighting (#3505). Ask: measure whether real fix checks are dropped, then decide. No lane started.
